Cabin Safety

Tháo ngắt cầu trượt thoát hiểm

The condition in which the emergency evacuation slides are disengaged from automatic deployment, typically after arrival or when opening doors normally.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

The condition in which the emergency evacuation slides are disengaged from automatic deployment, typically after arrival or when opening doors normally.

Operational example

Confirm with the flight deck that all slides are disarmed before opening any service doors after arrival.

Localized term
